patch_description: The current best program (score 0.93, sum 2.44) used an LP-based radius solver plus a hill-climb over centers, starting from a suboptimal 5/4/5/4/5/3 lattice. The current program has a better initial lattice (6/5/6/5/6 with a growth hole) but no center optimization, capping it at 2.00. I propose combining both strengths: keep the denser lattice as the starting layout, solve radii exactly with the LP at every step, and add a hill-climb over center positions. Crucially, per the corner-aware recommendation, I add directed moves that push circles touching two walls (corner circles) diagonally toward the nearest corner, where three-sided wall slack lets the LP assign them larger radii, and push single-wall circles away from walls. Small interior circles get larger jitter since they have more freedom. This should recover the ~2.44+ regime and improve on it via the denser seed.
